audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 4-5 read Skill while the whys[] line beside it says 'Level 4 is Cassiopeia's'.
audit.why: The mirror audit fixed this chart to Tryndamere / Skill / Cassiopeia / Cassiopeia / Skill / Cassiopeia / Tryndamere, and packet.levelChart also gives Levels 4-5 to Cassiopeia. Six of seven rows already agree; only row 3 was out of step and safe to move.
audit.corrected: Levels 4-5 set to Cassiopeia in both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers, so 'engage when Miasma is down' had no timeframe attached.
audit.why: Miasma is 24/22/20/18/16s — by far the longest cooldown in her lane kit — while Noxious Blast is 3.5s and Twin Fang 0.75s. That contrast is the whole shape of the matchup: two abilities that never go down and one that does.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d, spikes[0].text and mid now carry the 24s Miasma window and the 3.5s / 0.75s rotation.

audit.whatIsWrong: Petrifying Gaze was described as something to bait or side-angle, without stating the condition Riot actually gives: it stuns enemies facing her and only slows those with their back turned.
audit.why: This is the decisive interaction at level 6 and it is a directly playable instruction — turning away converts a stun into a slow — and it mirrors exactly how the opponent's page states Mocking Shout's own facing condition.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text, mid, wants.you[1] and wants.foe[2] now state the facing condition.

audit.whatIsWrong: Twin Fang's heal was never mentioned, so Grievous Wounds never appeared in the plan.
audit.why: Twin Fang heals her for a percentage of damage dealt and fires on a 0.75s cooldown into poisoned targets, which is how she wins an extended trade she should lose.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text and mid state the heal and put Grievous Wounds before the commit.
sources: enemyKit E text and heal flag

edits.before: Cassiopeia's lane: her Q Noxious Blast and W Miasma poison zone chip you constantly and her E Twin Fang resets on poisoned targets for heavy sustained DPS. Don't walk through her W puddle to engage, and time your all-in for when W is on cooldown.
edits.after: Cassiopeia's lane: Noxious Blast chips every 3.5s and Twin Fang fires on a 0.75s cooldown into poisoned targets, healing her as it goes. Miasma is the one long cooldown at 24s — that spent window is your engage, so never walk into the puddle.

edits.before: Skill-based at 6 but tense: her R Petrifying Gaze faces you down, so approach from an angle or bait it, and if she lands it you can pop Undying Rage to survive the follow-up E poison DPS.
edits.after: Skill-based at 6 but tense: Petrifying Gaze only stuns enemies facing her — turn away as she casts and you take a slow instead. If it does land, Undying Rage covers the Twin Fang follow-up.

edits.before: Level 4 is Cassiopeia's clear spot as her full poison rotation and W puddle deny your approach, and at level 6 her R Petrifying Gaze can lock you for a poison burst; keep it skill-based by angling around her ult and Undying Rage covers the follow-up if she lands it.
edits.after: Level 4 is Cassiopeia's clear spot as her full poison rotation and the 24s Miasma deny your approach, and Twin Fang heals her off every poisoned tick, so land Grievous Wounds before you commit; at 6 Petrifying Gaze stuns you only while you face her.

edits.before: Grounds you — dashes and movement abilities are disabled inside it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Miasma grounds you for its whole duration and it is 24s at rank 1 — engage once she has spent it.

edits.before: Bait or side-angle her R Petrifying Gaze
edits.after: Turn your back as Petrifying Gaze lands

edits.before: Face-check you with R Petrifying Gaze then poison-DPS
edits.after: Catch you facing her with Petrifying Gaze, then poison
